caption: The video captures a dense field of dark storm clouds filling the entire frame, their billowing surfaces rendered in deep gray-blue tones. A faint brighter edge lingers near the lower-left corner, while the central and right portions stay dark between pulses of light. The cloud mass appears largely fixed in layout, with no obvious translation or deformation. The illumination glows diffusely from within the clouds rather than as a visible bolt crossing the sky. A soft glow swells in the lower-center and right regions, lighting surrounding cloud edges before receding into darkness. A brightening then flickers low in the center and fades, followed by another localized flare in the lower-central clouds that subsides. A more extensive illumination develops across the central mass, with strong light spreading around dark silhouettes before dimming. A faint brightening reappears in the lower-center and left, gradually softening as the ongoing sequence of dark cloud illumination continues.
relations: Dense cloud mass remains fixed while diffuse internal illumination swells and recedes across lower-center and right regions.
Brightening flares low in the center, lighting surrounding cloud edges before fading into darkness.
Extensive internal glow develops across the central mass, spreading around dark silhouettes before dimming.
Faint brightening reappears in the lower-center and left, continuing the sequence of cloud illumination.
